photos.view_notes: Inspected comparisons and triplets for the selected ornate interior and red engraving. The smallest positive noise lift clarifies a few contour segments. Fine detail remains soft in both.

null.view_notes: Viewed intermediate slanted edge and ISO100 yellow. No discrete new edge or periodic profile is visible. Yellow color changes are modest in clipped sRGB.

null-adverse.view_notes: Viewed lowest and intermediate positive noise yellow. Both show a visible hue change, small on screen compared with the unclipped sensor-linear bias.

conditioning.view_notes: Viewed RGGB and GBRG. Both positive-conditioned columns show a yellow cast, including the ADC image. The zero-conditioned renders lose the visible cast.

interval.view_notes: Viewed lowest-positive RGGB yellow. The interval-excess correction is much closer in hue to the exact reference.

gfx.view_notes: Viewed eight boards, both cab sides and profiles, both SOOC JPEGs. Small grain differences; smooth sky, same coarse fence crossings, soft foliage, soft small hardware, and no new fine cab crossings.
